confidence_notes: Food estimates use current Peru-wide cost-of-living data alongside Ollantaytambo menu and visitor-guide prices; local prices vary between inexpensive menú spots and tourist-facing restaurants. Cocktail and wine estimates use their local restaurant price relationship to beer because dependable local typical-price data was weak. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates and least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Uses Peru cost-of-living ranges and Sacred Valley tourist-town prices as a basis; Ollantaytambo's visitor and train traffic supports a premium over purely local dining.
